title: 语法 · 状语从句｜原因、条件与让步 · 60 句
description: 原因结果、目的防范、条件、让步对照、方式地点和必要的时间关系。

items.zh: 由于拱门太低，货车无法驶入院子。
items.en: Because the arch is too low, the van cannot enter the yard.
answers: Because the arch is too low, the van cannot enter the yard.
Because the arch is too low, the van can't enter the yard.
items.notes: because 后接完整原因从句；主句不再加 so。

items.zh: 既然所有箱子都已编号，我们可以按号码查找。
items.en: Since every crate is numbered, we can locate them by number.
answers: Since every crate is numbered, we can locate them by number.
items.notes: since 在此表示既然，不是从某时起。

items.zh: 纸板太薄，装上把手后就弯了。
items.en: The cardboard was so thin that it bent when the handle was attached.
answers: The cardboard was so thin that it bent when the handle was attached.
items.notes: so + 形容词 + that 表结果。

items.zh: 这是一张如此复杂的路线图，以至于我们需要一个图例。
items.en: It is such a complicated route map that we need a legend.
answers: It is such a complicated route map that we need a legend.
items.notes: such + a + 形容词 + 名词；与 so complicated 区分。

items.zh: 她把收音机调得很轻，因此走廊上听不到。
items.en: She kept the radio so quiet that it could not be heard from the corridor.
answers: She kept the radio so quiet that it could not be heard from the corridor.
She kept the radio so quiet that it couldn't be heard from the corridor.
items.notes: so quiet that 描述程度造成的结果。

items.zh: 考虑到村里只有一条通路，封路必须提前告知。
items.en: As the village has only one access road, closures require advance notice.
answers: As the village has only one access road, closures require advance notice.
items.notes: as 引出已知背景原因，后接完整从句。

items.zh: 标签的位置让人看不见警告，因此我们移动了它。
items.en: The label concealed the warning, so we moved it.
answers: The label concealed the warning, so we moved it.
items.notes: so 连接结果分句，前面无需 because。

items.zh: 展柜非常沉，四个人才抬得动。
items.en: The display case was so heavy that it took four people to lift it.
answers: The display case was so heavy that it took four people to lift it.
items.notes: so ... that 引出所需人力这一结果。

items.zh: 这次测量有价值，是因为它让我们发现了偏差。
items.en: The measurement was valuable because it revealed a discrepancy.
answers: The measurement was valuable because it revealed a discrepancy.
items.notes: because 明确回答为什么有价值。

items.zh: 我提出问题并不是因为不信任你，而是因为记录不完整。
items.en: I asked not because I distrust you but because the record is incomplete.
answers: I asked not because I distrust you but because the record is incomplete.
items.notes: not because ... but because ... 对照两个原因。

items.zh: 把蓝图摊开，让所有人都能看清标注。
items.en: Spread out the blueprint so that everyone can read the annotations.
answers: Spread out the blueprint so that everyone can read the annotations.
items.notes: so that 表目的，主句为指令。

items.zh: 我们把数字放大，以便后排观众也能看见。
items.en: We enlarged the figures in order that the back row could see them.
answers: We enlarged the figures in order that the back row could see them.
items.notes: in order that + 完整从句表示目的。

items.zh: 不要挡住这个开关，以免有人紧急时找不到。
items.en: Keep the switch clear so that it can be found in an emergency.
answers: Keep the switch clear so that it can be found in an emergency.
items.notes: 目的从句中被动语态说明开关能被找到。

items.zh: 带上纸质地址，以防手机没电。
items.en: Take a paper copy of the address in case your phone runs out of power.
answers: Take a paper copy of the address in case your phone runs out of power.
items.notes: in case 表预防，不等于 if 条件成真才行动。

items.zh: 老师留出了停顿，让译员有时间完成翻译。
items.en: The teacher paused so that the interpreter had time to finish.
answers: The teacher paused so that the interpreter had time to finish.
items.notes: so that 说明停顿意图，关注不同主体。

items.zh: 我们遮住了答案，免得它影响观察者的判断。
items.en: We covered the answer so that it would not influence the observer.
answers: We covered the answer so that it would not influence the observer.
We covered the answer so that it wouldn't influence the observer.
items.notes: 目的从句用 would not 表希望避免的结果。

items.zh: 请保存原始包装，以防退货时需要。
items.en: Retain the original packaging in case it is needed for a return.
answers: Retain the original packaging in case it is needed for a return.
items.notes: in case 接完整可能情形，主句为事先准备。

items.zh: 我们把名字写得清楚些，以免信件再次送错。
items.en: We wrote the names clearly lest the letters be misdelivered again.
answers: We wrote the names clearly lest the letters be misdelivered again.
items.notes: lest 后可用动词原形 be，表示以免。

items.zh: 窗帘只拉开了一部分，为的是光线不会直接照到画上。
items.en: The curtains were opened only partway so that light would not fall directly on the painting.
answers: The curtains were opened only partway so that light would not fall directly on the painting.
The curtains were opened only partway so that light wouldn't fall directly on the painting.
items.notes: only partway 限定动作程度；so that 解释目的。

items.zh: 我把路线描述得很具体，让第一次来的人也能独自找到。
items.en: I described the route in detail so even a first-time visitor could find it unaided.
answers: I described the route in detail so even a first-time visitor could find it unaided.
items.notes: so 引出目的；unaided：无需帮助地。

items.zh: 如果密封圈变形，就需要更换，不能只拧紧。
items.en: If the seal is distorted, it needs replacing rather than tightening.
answers: If the seal is distorted, it needs replacing rather than tightening.
items.notes: if 表条件；两个动名词对照处理方法。

items.zh: 除非风速下降，否则今天不能升起横幅。
items.en: Unless the wind drops, the banner cannot be raised today.
answers: Unless the wind drops, the banner cannot be raised today.
Unless the wind drops, the banner can't be raised today.
items.notes: unless 相当于 if ... not，但不要在从句重复否定。

items.zh: 只要留出消防通道，这里可以摆放额外座椅。
items.en: Extra seating is permitted here as long as the fire exit route stays clear.
answers: Extra seating is permitted here as long as the fire exit route stays clear.
items.notes: as long as 引出许可的条件。

items.zh: 只有得到书面许可后，才可以移动档案。
items.en: The archives may be moved only if written permission is obtained.
answers: The archives may be moved only if written permission is obtained.
items.notes: only if 表必要条件，不表示满足后一定移动。

items.zh: 即使备用机器可用，我们也要先检查接口。
items.en: Even if the spare machine is available, we must check the connections first.
answers: Even if the spare machine is available, we must check the connections first.
items.notes: even if 表让步条件，结果不因条件成立而改变。

items.zh: 假如入口被锁，请使用墙上的对讲机。
items.en: In the event that the entrance is locked, use the intercom on the wall.
answers: In the event that the entrance is locked, use the intercom on the wall.
items.notes: in the event that 是正式的如果。

items.zh: 在双方都同意的条件下，可以交换展示时段。
items.en: Display slots can be exchanged provided that both parties agree.
answers: Display slots can be exchanged provided that both parties agree.
items.notes: provided that：前提是；双方同意才允许。

items.zh: 如果不是所有人都能看到屏幕，就把椅子向中间移。
items.en: If not everyone can see the screen, move the chairs towards the centre.
answers: If not everyone can see the screen, move the chairs towards the centre.
items.notes: not everyone 是部分否定，不等于 nobody。

items.zh: 遇到没有登记的访客时，应先联系接待人。
items.en: When an unregistered visitor arrives, contact the host first.
answers: When an unregistered visitor arrives, contact the host first.
items.notes: when 在程序中表示每次发生该情形时。

items.zh: 是否使用大门，要看送货车能否安全转弯。
items.en: Whether we use the main gate depends on whether the van can turn safely.
answers: Whether we use the main gate depends on whether the van can turn safely.
items.notes: 两个 whether 表待确定事项，不误写条件 if ... then。

items.zh: 虽然封面已经磨损，里面的图纸仍很清楚。
items.en: Although the cover is worn, the drawings inside remain clear.
answers: Although the cover is worn, the drawings inside remain clear.
items.notes: although 从句后不再加 but。

items.zh: 即便这块玻璃看起来完好，也要检查边缘。
items.en: Even though the glass looks intact, its edges still need inspection.
answers: Even though the glass looks intact, its edges still need inspection.
items.notes: even though 承认实际情况后作让步。

items.zh: 不管支架有多结实，都必须固定在地上。
items.en: However sturdy the stand is, it must be secured to the ground.
answers: However sturdy the stand is, it must be secured to the ground.
items.notes: however + 形容词 + 主语 + 谓语，表示无论多么。

items.zh: 无论谁来安装，最后都需要独立检查。
items.en: Whoever installs it, an independent check is required at the end.
answers: Whoever installs it, an independent check is required at the end.
items.notes: whoever 在此引导让步状语从句，不作主句主语。

items.zh: 无论把灯放在哪里，镜子里都能看到它。
items.en: Wherever we put the lamp, it appears in the mirror.
answers: Wherever we put the lamp, it appears in the mirror.
items.notes: wherever：无论在哪里；主句结果不受地点变化影响。

items.zh: 金属框架能承重，而织物只起遮挡作用。
items.en: The metal frame bears the load, whereas the fabric provides a screen.
answers: The metal frame bears the load, whereas the fabric provides a screen.
items.notes: whereas 对照功能，不是时间上的同时。

items.zh: 尽管我认可这个目标，但不认为现有工具足够。
items.en: While I accept the objective, I doubt that the current tools are adequate.
answers: While I accept the objective, I doubt that the current tools are adequate.
items.notes: while 在此表虽然，不表动作同步。

items.zh: 尽管搬运很困难，他们仍保留了整块石碑。
items.en: Difficult as it was to move, they kept the stone monument intact.
answers: Difficult as it was to move, they kept the stone monument intact.
items.notes: 形容词前置 + as 表让步，主句无需 but。

items.zh: 无论你选择哪种配色，都要保留文字对比度。
items.en: Whichever colour scheme you choose, keep the text contrast high.
answers: Whichever colour scheme you choose, keep the text contrast high.
items.notes: whichever 引导有限选项内的让步条件。

items.zh: 即使反馈不尽相同，也不能因此跳过复核。
items.en: Even if feedback varies, that is no reason to skip the review.
answers: Even if feedback varies, that is no reason to skip the review.
items.notes: even if 后承认可能差异；主句说明不变结论。

items.zh: 把标尺放在光线能照到的地方。
items.en: Place the ruler where the light reaches it.
answers: Place the ruler where the light reaches it.
items.notes: where 从句作地点状语，前面没有地点先行词。

items.zh: 按照图中所示的顺序连接管道。
items.en: Connect the pipes as the diagram shows.
answers: Connect the pipes as the diagram shows.
items.notes: as 表按照，方式从句不同于 because 原因。

items.zh: 他检查零件的方式就像知道它哪里坏了一样。
items.en: He examined the part as if he knew where it was damaged.
answers: He examined the part as if he knew where it was damaged.
items.notes: as if 表仿佛；knew 表假设性方式而非主叙事时态训练。

items.zh: 有台阶的地方也需要提供另一条路线。
items.en: An alternative route is needed wherever there are steps.
answers: An alternative route is needed wherever there are steps.
items.notes: wherever 表所有满足地点条件之处。

items.zh: 按原样保留标签，直到来源核实完毕。
items.en: Leave the label as it is until its source is verified.
answers: Leave the label as it is until its source is verified.
items.notes: as it is 表保持原状；until 表终点条件。

items.zh: 把重物放在地板有额外支撑的地方。
items.en: Put the heavy objects where the floor has extra support.
answers: Put the heavy objects where the floor has extra support.
items.notes: where 说明放置位置，不需要额外介词 in。

items.zh: 他把模型捧得像里面装着水一样。
items.en: He carried the model as though it contained water.
answers: He carried the model as though it contained water.
items.notes: as though 引出想象中的方式。

items.zh: 新图例必须像旧图例那样解释缩写。
items.en: The new legend must explain abbreviations as the old one did.
answers: The new legend must explain abbreviations as the old one did.
items.notes: as 从句表达方式一致；did 替代重复动作。

items.zh: 请站在镜头拍不到你的地方。
items.en: Stand where the camera cannot capture you.
answers: Stand where the camera cannot capture you.
Stand where the camera can't capture you.
items.notes: where 后接完整陈述句，作地点状语。

items.zh: 连接处应按设计的方式活动，而不能被胶水固定死。
items.en: The joint must move as intended rather than be held rigid by glue.
answers: The joint must move as intended rather than be held rigid by glue.
items.notes: as intended 为 as it was intended 的省略结构。

items.zh: 门锁解开之后，再转动把手。
items.en: Turn the handle once the lock is released.
answers: Turn the handle once the lock is released.
items.notes: once 表一旦，时间从句用一般现在时指将来步骤。

items.zh: 胶水尚未固定时，不要移动框架。
items.en: Do not move the frame while the glue is still setting.
answers: Do not move the frame while the glue is still setting.
Don't move the frame while the glue is still setting.
items.notes: while 表持续背景，重点是动作并行关系。

items.zh: 每次更换滚轮，都检查轴是否弯曲。
items.en: Whenever you replace a wheel, check whether the axle is bent.
answers: Whenever you replace a wheel, check whether the axle is bent.
items.notes: whenever 表每次；whether 是 check 的宾语从句。

items.zh: 在第二个人握稳之前，别松手。
items.en: Keep hold until the second person has a firm grip.
answers: Keep hold until the second person has a firm grip.
items.notes: until 表动作保持到终点。

items.zh: 你刚打开盖子，就能闻到木材的气味。
items.en: As soon as you lift the lid, you can smell the wood.
answers: As soon as you lift the lid, you can smell the wood.
items.notes: as soon as：一……就……，表达紧接关系。

items.zh: 绳索越拉越紧时，注意支架是否移动。
items.en: As the rope tightens, watch for movement in the support.
answers: As the rope tightens, watch for movement in the support.
items.notes: as 表两个过程同步变化。

items.zh: 在你接线之前，确认标签没有被交换。
items.en: Before you connect the wires, confirm that the labels have not been switched.
answers: Before you connect the wires, confirm that the labels have not been switched.
Before you connect the wires, confirm that the labels haven't been switched.
items.notes: before 给出先后顺序；that 说明核实内容。

items.zh: 当所有出口清空后，工作人员才允许入场。
items.en: Staff allow entry only when every exit is clear.
answers: Staff allow entry only when every exit is clear.
items.notes: only when 强调允许入场的时机条件。

items.zh: 一旦塑料变硬，就很难再调整形状。
items.en: Once the plastic hardens, reshaping it becomes difficult.
answers: Once the plastic hardens, reshaping it becomes difficult.
items.notes: once 强调跨过某阶段后的状态变化。

items.zh: 只要机器还在运转，就保持盖子关闭。
items.en: Keep the lid shut for as long as the machine is running.
answers: Keep the lid shut for as long as the machine is running.
items.notes: for as long as 表整个持续期间，不是条件习语 as long as 的许可义。
